lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized into roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spacing between centroids increases along the longitudinal axis towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a clear grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior surface and shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, high-luminance spots concentrated along the anterior leading edge.
